description: s.397(2)(b)(ii) (NOT the deduction side's s.397(2)(b)(i)): where the collectee furnishes no PAN, tax is collected at the HIGHER of twice the rate in force and 5%, not exceeding 20%. Scrap is 2% since 1-4-2026; max(2 x 2%, 5%) = 5%, which is under the 20% ceiling. 5,00,000 x 5% = 25,000. Hand-computed. Note this is 5%, NOT the 20% the deduction side would impose — the two no-PAN regimes differ and must not be collapsed. The expected values here are UNCHANGED by the scrap rate correction because the 5% floor still dominates; only the arithmetic in this description moved.
